distribution.en: Neotropics, Central America and the Caribbean, widely distributed in northern South America, Belize, Bolivia, Brazil, Cayman Islands, Colombia, Costa Rica, Cuba, Dominican Republic, Grenada, Guadeloupe (France), Guatemala, Guyana, Haiti, Honduras, Jamaica, Martinique (France), Mexico, Montserrat, Netherlands Antilles, Nicaragua, Panama, Puerto Rico, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Anguilla, Saint Lucia, Trinidad and Tobago, Venezuela, U.S. Virgin Islands, introduced: Bahamas
distribution.zh: 新热带界、中美洲及加勒比、南美北部广泛分布、伯利兹、玻利维亚、巴西、开曼群岛、哥伦比亚、哥斯达黎加、古巴、多米尼加共和国、格林纳达、瓜德罗普（法）、危地马拉、圭亚那、海地、洪都拉斯、牙买加、马提尼克（法）、墨西哥、蒙特塞拉特、荷属安的列斯、尼加拉瓜、巴拿马、波多黎各、圣基茨和尼维斯、安圭拉、圣卢西亚、特立尼达和多巴哥、委内瑞拉、美属维尔京群岛、引入：巴哈马
